blogs.title: Forensic Science Postgraduate Crowned Forever Miss Deoghar 2025; Nidhi Netra Says, "Confidence Comes from Believing in Yourself Every Single Day"
blogs.short_content: Nidhi Netra, being crowned Forever Miss Deoghar 2025 under the Forever Miss India platform by Forever Star India. If you have the confidenceto represent your city, this is your opportunity to shine on a national platf…
blogs.content:
Winning a beauty pageant is often seen as the final destination, but for Nidhi Netra, being crowned Forever Miss Deoghar 2025 is just the beginning of a much bigger journey. A postgraduate in Forensic Science from Chandigarh University and currently working as an IT Project Coordinator in Noida, Nidhi has proved that education, professional success, and creativity can go hand in hand.

After winning the prestigious Forever Miss Deoghar 2025 title under the Forever Miss India platform by Forever Star India, Nidhi spoke to NewsForever about her journey, balancing a corporate career with her dreams, and the message she wants to share with young women across the country.

"Winning the Crown is a Responsibility, Not Just an Achievement"

Speaking to NewsForever, Nidhi said that the crown represents much more than a personal milestone.

"Winning Forever Miss Deoghar 2025 is a dream come true for me. This title is not just an achievement but also a responsibility. I want to inspire young women to believe that education, career, and personal dreams can grow together. Success doesn't come from choosing one path over another it comes from giving your best to every opportunity that life offers."

From Forensic Science to the Fashion Stage

Q. Your academic background is in Forensic Science, while your profession is in IT. How did the pageant world become part of your journey?

Nidhi: My journey has always been about learning and challenging myself. Studying Forensic Science taught me discipline, analytical thinking, and attention to detail. Later, working as an IT Project Coordinator strengthened my leadership, communication, and management skills. Alongside my professional life, I always loved creative activities like classical dance and art. Participating in Forever Miss India gave me the opportunity to bring together every part of my personality on one platform.

"Growth Happens Outside Your Comfort Zone"

Q. What motivated you to participate in Forever Miss India?

Nidhi: I wanted to step outside my comfort zone and discover my true potential. Forever Star India gave me a platform where personality, confidence, communication, and purpose are valued as much as appearance. Every stage of the competition taught me something new about myself. It wasn't only about winning a title it was about becoming a more confident and stronger individual.

Balancing Career and Passion

Q. Managing a corporate career while preparing for a pageant must have been challenging. How did you do it?

Nidhi: It certainly required discipline and proper time management. My work responsibilities remained my priority, so I planned my schedule carefully to make time for fitness, grooming, and personal preparation. I also continued pursuing activities like classical dance, squash, and mandala art because they helped me stay creative and mentally balanced throughout the journey.

A Message for Every Young Woman

Q. What message would you like to share with girls who dream of participating in beauty pageants?

Nidhi: Never underestimate yourself because of your background or profession. Whether you're a student, a working professional, or someone just beginning your journey, your dreams are valid. Believe in yourself, work consistently, and never stop learning. Confidence is built through preparation, perseverance, and self-belief. Every woman has the potential to create her own identity if she is willing to take the first step.

What's Next for Nidhi Netra?

Following her victory as Miss Deoghar 2025, Nidhi aims to continue growing both professionally and personally while representing Deoghar on larger platforms. She hopes to inspire more young women to pursue higher education, build successful careers, and confidently follow their passions without compromising their individuality.

Want to Begin Your Own Journey?

Inspired by Nidhi Netra's story? Forever Miss India by Forever Star India is inviting aspiring women from across India to participate in its upcoming editions. If you have the confidence, talent, and determination to represent your city, this is your opportunity to shine on a national platform.

blogs.title: Once Miss Maharashtra 2025 Runner Up Now a Doctor: Success Journey of Shivani Rambhau Suryawanshi
blogs.short_content: Inspiring journey of Shivani Rambhau Suryawanshi, Miss Maharashtra 2025 Runner Up, who balanced pageantry and medicine to become a doctor. A story of determination and success.
blogs.content:
When Shivani Rambhau Suryawanshi was crowned Miss Maharashtra 2025 Runner Up, she captured attention with her confidence, grace, and inspiring personality. However, for Shivani, the title was never the final destination; it was one milestone in a much larger journey. Today, she proudly adds another remarkable achievement to her name: Doctor.

Hailing from Latur, Maharashtra, Shivani's story is a powerful example of how determination, hard work, and self-belief can turn multiple dreams into reality.

How did the motivation provided by Forever Miss India help in becoming a doctor?

Behind every crown lies a story of dedication, and Shivani's journey is no exception. While making her mark in the pageant world, she was simultaneously pursuing one of the most challenging professional paths: medicine.

Balancing academic responsibilities with personal growth and public appearances required discipline, resilience, and an unwavering commitment to her goals. Despite the challenges, she remained focused on her vision and continued moving forward with determination.

Stepped into the Beauty Pageant Industry with Forever Miss India

Shivani's pageant journey began with her victory as Miss Latur 2025 under Forever Star India. Her authenticity, confidence, intelligence, and strong sense of purpose helped her stand out among contestants.

Her impressive performance at the state level earned her the prestigious title of Miss Maharashtra 2025 Runner Up, making her one of the most admired participants of the competition. Through her journey, she demonstrated that pageants are not just about beauty, they are platforms that empower women to build confidence, leadership, and self-belief.

How was Shivani Rambhau's dream of becoming a doctor fulfilled?

While her pageant success brought her recognition, Shivani never lost sight of her ultimate goal. After years of dedication, rigorous training, and academic commitment, she successfully completed her medical education and became a doctor.

This achievement marks the fulfillment of a dream she worked tirelessly toward for years. Her journey from the pageant stage to the medical profession showcases the power of perseverance and the importance of staying committed to one's aspirations.

How did Shivani Rambhau become a guiding light for the women of India?

Shivani's story resonates with countless young women who aspire to pursue multiple dreams. She proves that success is not about choosing one path over another but about having the courage and determination to pursue every goal with passion.

Her journey encourages aspiring pageant contestants, students, and young professionals to believe in themselves and continue striving for excellence, regardless of the challenges they face.

The story of Shivani's dreams and her determination regarding the 'Crown'

Today, Dr. Shivani Rambhau Suryawanshi stands as an inspiring symbol of ambition, dedication, and achievement. From earning the title of Miss Maharashtra 2025 Runner Up to achieving her dream of becoming a doctor, she has shown that confidence gained through one journey can help create success in another.

Her story is a reminder that a crown can be a milestone, but true success lies in continuing to grow, achieve, and make a meaningful impact on the world.

The Forever Star India Awards (FSIA) has become one of the emerging platforms in India that highlights talent, achievements, and inspiring journeys across multiple fields. But the most frequently asked question is—who can become a part of Forever Star India Awards?

The answer is simple: any individual with talent, achievement, or an inspiring journey can apply for the Forever Star India Awards.

Forever Star India Awards – A National Recognition Platform

The Forever Star India Awards is a recognition platform in India designed to honor individuals from different professions and backgrounds. It focuses on celebrating real achievements, hidden talent, and inspirational success stories rather than just fame or popularity.

Whether you are a professional, entrepreneur, artist, or social contributor, FSIA provides a stage where your work can gain visibility and recognition at a wider level.

Who Is Eligible for Forever Star India Awards?

The eligibility for Forever Star India Awards nomination is broad and inclusive. Individuals from multiple sectors can become part of FSIA, including:

 Professionals and Experts

Doctors, lawyers, teachers, consultants, engineers, and business professionals who have contributed significantly in their respective fields can apply for FSIA awards. Their expertise, dedication, and professional achievements make them strong candidates for recognition.

Social Workers and Changemakers

People involved in social work, women empowerment, education, healthcare awareness, and community development are also eligible. FSIA recognizes individuals who are making a positive impact on society through their efforts.

Artists, Influencers & Creators

Content creators, digital influencers, performers, writers, photographers, and artists can become a part of the Forever Star India Awards nomination process. Their creativity, engagement, and influence make them important contributors in today’s digital era.

 Inspiring Personalities & Transformation Stories

Individuals who have overcome challenges such as financial struggles, health issues, or personal setbacks and turned their lives into success stories are highly valued at FSIA. These inspiring journeys reflect strength, motivation, and resilience.

 Students and Emerging Talent

Young achievers, students, and beginners showing excellence in academics, sports, creativity, or entrepreneurship can also apply. FSIA encourages emerging talent recognition platform in India and helps them build early visibility.

What Makes You Eligible for FSIA Awards?

The Forever Star India Awards eligibility criteria is not based on fame or followers. Instead, it focuses on:

  • Your journey and story
  • Your achievements and contribution
  • Your skills and dedication
  • Your impact on society or industry
  • Your growth and transformation

This makes FSIA a platform where even lesser-known individuals can gain national-level recognition.

Why Join Forever Star India Awards?

Becoming a part of the Forever Star India Awards India platform offers multiple benefits:

  • National recognition and visibility
  • Digital presence and branding
  • Professional credibility enhancement
  • Opportunity to showcase your journey
  • Inclusion in award nominee listings and features

It helps individuals strengthen their personal branding and keyword reach online, making their achievements more discoverable in search engines.

Conclusion

So, who can become a part of Forever Star India Awards?

Anyone with a talent, achievement, inspirational journey, or social contribution can apply for FSIA recognition. The platform is built to honor real people and real success stories across India.

The Forever Star India Awards 2026 continues to provide a powerful stage where individuals are not judged by fame but by their impact, dedication, and journey.

In simple words if your story inspires, you are eligible for FSIA recognition.

blogs.title: Beauty Pageant Scams in India: Why Contestants Are Demanding Transparency & Trust
blogs.short_content: Beauty Pageant scams in India are increasing as contestants demand trusted, GST registered & genuine beauty pageant platforms. Learn how to identify authentic modeling & pageant organizations.
blogs.content:
India’s beauty and fashion industry is expanding at a remarkable pace. From Rajasthan, Delhi, Punjab, Gujarat, Maharashtra, and Karnataka to several other regions, thousands of aspiring models, talented women, and future beauty queens are actively participating in beauty pageants, modeling competitions, fashion shows, and online auditions to build successful careers in the glamour and fashion industry.

With the rapid rise of social media influence and digital audition platforms, opportunities in the beauty pageant industry have increased significantly. Contestants are continuously searching for trusted beauty pageant platforms, Miss India opportunities, Mrs India competitions, national-level talent shows, and professional modeling organizations that can offer genuine exposure, recognition, and career growth.

However, alongside this rapid expansion, concerns regarding fake beauty pageant platforms and online modeling scams are also increasing across India.

Fake Beauty Pageant Platforms & Online Modeling Scams Increasing Across India

Many contestants across the country have reported concerning experiences involving fake beauty pageant organizations and unverified modeling platforms operating without proper transparency or legal authorization.

During research conducted across Rajasthan, Delhi, Punjab, Karnataka, Gujarat, Maharashtra, and several other states, it was observed that multiple beauty pageant and modeling platforms were functioning without GST registration, verified business identity, or professional operational systems.

According to participants, several organizations were collecting registration fees, audition charges, portfolio payments, and participation fees while offering misleading promises regarding titles, selection, and career opportunities. In many cases, contestants later discovered that these platforms lacked official credibility, structured event management, and genuine industry presence.

This situation has created confusion, financial concerns, and trust issues among aspiring participants who genuinely wish to build careers in fashion, glamour, modeling, and beauty competitions. Parents and guardians are also becoming increasingly cautious before allowing participation in any online audition or beauty pageant platform.

Why Contestants Prefer Trusted & GST Registered Beauty Pageant Platforms

Due to rising awareness about fake pageant scams and online modeling frauds, contestants are now actively choosing verified and professionally managed beauty pageant organizations.

Today, aspiring participants prefer platforms that are:

  • GST Registered
  • Professionally Managed
  • Legally Verified
  • Transparent & Authentic
  • Industry Recognized

Experts from the beauty and fashion industry strongly recommend that contestants verify essential details before making any payments or joining any beauty contest, modeling competition, fashion event, or national-level pageant.

Key verification points include:

  • GST Registration and Legal Identity
  • Official Website Authenticity
  • Social Media Credibility and Engagement
  • Past Events, Winners, and Track Record
  • Organizer Transparency and Communication
  • Business Legitimacy and Industry Presence

These checks help contestants differentiate between genuine opportunities and misleading or fraudulent platforms in the beauty pageant industry.

Transparency and Trust Becoming Essential in the Pageant Industry

Transparency has become a key factor in India’s evolving beauty pageant ecosystem. Today’s contestants are not only focused on winning titles but also on safety, professionalism, credibility, and long-term career development.

Trusted beauty pageant platforms provide structured guidance, personality development, confidence building, and professional exposure in the fashion and modeling industry. Such organizations create a safe and empowering environment where women from different states can grow, learn, and showcase their talent.

Forever Star India Gaining Trust Among Contestants Across India

Among the few platforms receiving positive recognition from participants, Forever Star India is emerging as a trusted beauty pageant platform in India. Contestants appreciated the organization for its transparent process, GST registered operations, professional management, and genuine opportunities for women from different states.

Participants stated that trusted platforms help women feel more confident, secure, and motivated while participating in beauty pageants, fashion events, and national modeling competitions.

Awareness About Fake Pageant Scams Is More Important Than Ever

As India’s beauty, fashion, and modeling industry continues to grow rapidly, awareness regarding fake beauty pageant scams, online modeling frauds, and unregistered beauty pageant organizations is becoming increasingly important.

Contestants and families are now encouraging aspiring participants to choose only verified and trusted beauty pageant platforms that genuinely support women empowerment, talent development, confidence building, beauty with purpose, and career growth in fashion and modeling.

The demand for authentic, transparent, and professionally managed beauty pageant organizations in India continues to rise, as aspiring contestants seek safe and genuine platforms to achieve their dreams with confidence and security.

blogs.title: Kerala Assembly Elections: NDA Shows Strong Prospects of Leading
blogs.short_content: Kerala Assembly Elections see NDA gaining strong momentum with rising voter support, strategic campaigning, and shifting political dynamics across the state.
blogs.content:
The upcoming Kerala Assembly elections are proving to be a well-term hard fought contest with the National Democratic Alliance (NDA) making some encouraging moves in this regard. Analysts attribute the emerging prospects of NDA to both the strategic campaigning, issues on the ground and the changing voter sentiment. According to the political observers, the Kerala traditional favoritism towards regional parties and the Left Democratic Front (LDF) is being rekindled by the current NDA tactic.

Rising Momentum for NDA

Political strategists report that the NDA has been in a position to exploit the amount of dissatisfaction experienced by the masses on the part of the ruling government, especially on matters like development of infrastructure, creation of employment opportunities, and economic development. Although control by the LDF and the United Democratic Front (UDF) has been a long time experience in the state, the rise of the NDA in urban and semi-urban constituencies cannot be ruled out.

Development-focused policies have been highlighted by the leaders of the alliance which promise the people better infrastructure and creation of employment opportunities among other measures on the social welfare. These appeals attract the younger generation of voters and those who are first time voters, who are becoming a formidable force in the Kerala political arena.

Strategic Campaigning and Candidate Selection

Another significant factor that has contributed to the emerging opportunities of NDA is its selective process of selecting candidates. Through nominating leaders with a high number of appeal and credibility in the localities, the alliance is seeking to gain the trust of voters who might have been unwilling to transfer their political alliances. More to the point, analysts mention that the credibility of candidates, paired with highly successful social media campaigns and campaigns carried out on the ground, has enabled NDA to achieve an apparent, state-wide presence.

Roadshows, voter engagement programs and campaign rallies have been increased within the last couple of months. This course of action seems to be bearing fruits as opinion polls show that the public is now more in favor of NDA, especially in the districts which were previously thought as bastions of regional parties.

Voter Sentiments and Shifting Dynamics

There are slight changes in the public opinion in Kerala and they are also influenced by the rising inflation rates, unemployment and lack of satisfaction with current development rates in the country. Although the voters of Kerala have had an inclination to be coalition party members historically, there is currently an indication that voters are now more willing to look beyond party affiliation and seek alternatives that will bring about tangible benefits.

Scholars assume that the NDA has performed better in other southern states as well, which has also led to the view that the alliance is a viable option in governance. This is the comparative approach one that is raising the eyebrows of many a voter, and the following elections are going to be a contested race.

Influence of National Politics

The increased opportunities of the NDA in Kerala are also being linked to the national political trends. Having more visibility and a strong campaign machinery, the alliance is basically using the schemes and policies of the central government to legitimize its role within the state. This strategy seems to be winning the attraction of voters who are more focused on development and efficiency in governance than the conventional political affiliations.

Also, thanks to social media campaigns that emphasize the success of the NDA on the national level, it has been able to reach a large audience, having an impact on the opinions of younger voters and the urban population. This online outreach together with traditional campaigning is becoming a powerful force to the alliance.

A Competitive Political Landscape

The political environment in Kerala is still complicated and regional alliances still very strong. The recent wave of NDA encouragement however refers to the fact that the old NDF and UDF supremacy is under fire. Political analysts believe that the forthcoming elections may be characterized by some surprising results in some of the states, as there would be increased dynamism in the voters which is not the case during the past years.

With the coming of the election day, all the main political parties are increasing the attempts to unify their voter-turnout. The rising wave of the NDA will contend that this electoral year is a possible transition of the current trend of governing Kerala, which might change the previous trends of ruling in the state.

blogs.title: Market Alert: Silver May See a Major Surge After April 14
blogs.short_content: Market alert: Silver may see a major breakout after April 14 driven by industrial demand, safe-haven buying, and strong technical indicators.
blogs.content:
The global silver market is showing strong bullish signals, raising expectations of a significant price surge after April 14. Investors and analysts are closely monitoring these developments as silver gains momentum amid increasing volatility in the commodities market. With both industrial and investment demand on the rise, silver is emerging as a promising asset with strong growth potential.

Silver prices today are seeing steady movement, with the current silver rate around ₹2,25,000 per kg, drawing increased attention from investors. The precious metal market is showing early signs of a potential breakout, making this an important time for those tracking commodity trends.

Strong Technical Indicators Signal Breakout

Market experts highlight that silver is forming a powerful technical pattern that suggests a possible breakout in the coming days. Prices are currently testing key resistance levels, and once these are crossed, a sharp upward rally could follow.

Indicators such as rising lows and tightening consolidation ranges point toward a classic bullish setup. Additionally, trading volumes are increasing, which often supports upward price movement. Momentum indicators like RSI and MACD are also trending positively, reinforcing expectations of a strong price surge. If this breakout materializes, it could attract both short-term traders and long-term investors.

Rising Industrial Demand Driving Prices

A major factor behind the optimistic outlook is the growing industrial demand for silver. The metal plays a crucial role in electronics, solar panels, and electric vehicles. As global economies accelerate their transition toward clean energy, silver consumption is rising rapidly.

This surge in demand is putting pressure on supply chains, which could further accelerate price growth. Analysts note that even a small increase in industrial usage can significantly impact prices due to limited supply expansion.

Safe Haven Demand Adds Momentum

Beyond industrial use, silver is also gaining popularity as a safe-haven investment. Economic uncertainty, inflation concerns, and currency fluctuations are pushing investors toward precious metals.

While gold remains the primary safe-haven asset, silver is increasingly viewed as a more affordable alternative with higher upside potential. With expectations of increased market volatility after April 14, demand for silver as a protective investment is likely to grow.

Global Economic Factors Supporting Silver Rally

Several global factors are aligning in favor of a silver price rally. Central bank policies, interest rate expectations, and movements in the US dollar are influencing precious metal markets. A weaker dollar typically supports higher silver prices, making it more attractive to international investors.

Additionally, ongoing geopolitical tensions and trade uncertainties are encouraging investment in commodities. These factors collectively strengthen the outlook for a sustained silver price increase.

Investor Strategy and Market Outlook

Analysts advise investors to closely watch price movements between mid-April and mid-June. A breakout above resistance levels could mark the beginning of a strong upward trend. Both retail and institutional investors may increase their exposure if bullish momentum continues.

Diversification strategies are also driving interest in silver, as investors look for assets that can hedge against inflation and market instability. The expected surge in silver prices could present significant opportunities for those entering the market at the right time.

Families that could not be sure about the unconventional paths of careers are now seen to have their heads raised in joy because of such accomplishments. It is not just that individuals change but wholesale households and communities are changing. Parents who used to doubt and challenge these dreams are the pillars of support today as they see their children emerge as heroes in their locality.

The influence of the initiative is gradually growing to include areas of the country where it has been previously difficult to gain exposure. Forever Star India is disrupting a paradigm by transforming talents into opportunity, making it a movement which glorifies diversity, ambitions and courage.

blogs.content:
When you enter a beauty contest, it is really not about the walk, it is about charm and confidence. If you wish to participate in an Indian beauty contest, beauty pageant or contest for Miss India, Miss Universe, Mrs India, Miss Teen India, then you need to be ready for it and take tips from experts and do prior planning. Organisations such as Forever Star India (FSIA) have revolutionised the world of beauty pageants, providing grooming and preparation and national visibility for their contestants. FSIA is one of the largest beauty pageant platforms in India which provides exposure and opportunities for contestants from every corner of the country to display talent, personality and poise on a national and even international level. Here are the top 5 tips to make your pageant dreams a success.

Build Strong Confidence and Personality

Being confident is important for a beauty pageant participant. Contestants should radiate confidence and honesty. Refine your speaking, body positioning and movement to make a memorable impression on the judges' panel during your beauty contest journey.

Pay Attention to Grooming and Training

Personal grooming is an important aspect of  Miss India or Mrs Universe  beauty contests. Competitions such as FSIA groom contestants for the stage and beyond, by providing styling, style and character-building classes.

Enhance Your Talent and Skills

All beauty pageant in India have talent competitions where each candidate displays their skills. Talents can get you noticed, as well as the chances for success in dancing, speaking, and more.

Maintain Fitness and Wellness

It is important to be healthy and fit, but so is it important to be happy. Eating well and sticking to a diet and regular exercise helps keep you awake, happy at the pageant. Health and wellness are now a key theme in many pageants.

Have a Purpose and a Cause

Contemporary beauty pageants, such as Miss Universe and Miss India competition, are looking for contestants with a purpose. Your cause may be women empowerment, social awareness or anything else but you need to have a strong message.

Final Thoughts

To win a beauty contest, it is not just about your appearance, but also who you are on the inside and how wise you can be and how much wisdom you carry that inspires people. With preparation and guidance from the various organisations such as Forever Star India, you can even achieve your dreams. FSIA is the perfect platform for contestants from all over the country to receive recognition, training and exposure on the stage.

Many winners go on to represent their country on global stages such as Miss Universe and Mrs Universe. These competitions provide worldwide exposure, professional networking, and career opportunities in fields such as modeling, acting, entrepreneurship, and social advocacy. Understanding these pathways can help participants choose a pageant that supports their ambitions and long-term goals.

Preparing for a Successful Pageant Journey

Contestants competing in events like Miss India, Mrs India, and Miss Teen India often undergo grooming sessions, interviews, and talent rounds to showcase their abilities. blogs.content:
A Grand Celebration of Excellence and Leadership

The National Achievers Recognition 2026 proudly honored 30 exceptional personalities from across the nation under the distinguished super woman award and super hero awards categories. The ceremony celebrated people who have demonstrated excellence, innovation, leadership, and strong social commitment in their respective fields. From entrepreneurship and generation to social provider, spirituality, arts, and governance, the awardees represent the real spirit of modern India.

Honoring Excellence Across Diverse Fields

Among the distinguished honorees, Neetu Rudrakshi Jharotia (Ajmer) was recognized for her outstanding contribution as a fiction writer, while Shirin Zakiuddin Gorakhpurwala (Udaipur) earned appreciation as a homemade professional chef. Pune showcased talent through Meghana Tarawade, numerologist and healer, and Adv. Veebha Singh, advocate and legal advisor. Mumbai added pride with Kunjal Vira, astrologer; Vishakha Mule, model; and Farzana Sajid, chef.

In the spiritual and guidance domain, Rohit Pitambar Wallujwar (Chandrapur) and Pandit Sandeep Kumar Shastry (Noida) were honored for astrology, alongside Ishwari Gopal Shah (Bharuch) for tarot reading and Dr. Sona Valecha (Ahmedabad) as an Akashic Record Reader. Tourism and technology were represented by Sanwar Singh Rawat (Pushkar) in tour and travel services, Sabitha Sriram (Chennai) in AI risk management, and Maj (Dr) Priti Sharma (Jabalpur) as a global visionary in AI defense logistics.

Entrepreneurship, Creativity, and Public Service

Entrepreneurial excellence was celebrated through achievers like Annisha D Poria (Hyderabad), Rajni Jain (Siliguri), and Preeti Chauhan (Raipur), while Dr. Mehulsinh Thakore (Vadodara) was acknowledged for leading the No.1 EPC solar company. Creativity flourished with Sudeepthi Somireddy (Rajahmundry) as an artist and Usha Malviya (Pali) as a fashion designer.

Public service and community leadership were equally recognized. Amrita Singh (Indore), Dr. Sampati Mishra (Sikar), and Gaurav Agarwal (Hojai) were honored for impactful social work. Pushpa Kukreti (Raipur) contributed through financial consultancy, and Hiral Mane (Vadodara) empowered lives as a life coach. Government leadership and legal excellence were represented by Shailja Sharma (Mandi), Assistant GST Commissioner; Adv. Uma Anil Bhattad (Nagpur); and Dr. Parmod Mann (Delhi) for his role in physical education and sexual harassment prevention in Kho-Kho.

Inspiring a Nation Through Recognition

The super hero awards and super woman awards categories recognize not only professional achievements but also dedication to nation-building and societal growth. These awardees stand as role models, proving that success can emerge from creativity, service, leadership, innovation, and entrepreneurship.

Through such national recognitions, India continues to celebrate changemakers who inspire communities and shape the future with courage, integrity, and visionary leadership.

Forever Mrs. India Grand Finale Season 5 Shines at Zee Studio, Jaipur

From Jharkhand, Anjali Sinha emerged victorious as Forever Mrs. India 2025 (G1 Category), while Bhumika Songra from Madhya Pradesh clinched the Forever Mrs. India 2025 title in the G2 Category.

In the runner-up positions, Priya Yogesh Chaudhary from Maharashtra secured the Runner-Up title in G1, whereas Anupama Sharma from Chandigarh was crowned First Runner-Up in G2. Additionally, Khushboo Singh from Maharashtra earned the title of Second Runner-Up in the G2 category.

State Title Winners Honored Across India

Founder Rajesh Agarwal and Director Jaya Chauhan of Forever Star India shared that participants from different states were honored with Forever Mrs. India State Titles, celebrating regional talent and cultural diversity across the country. In the G1 category, the state title winners included Janhvi Jasmine from Jharkhand, Shweta Vishwakarma as First Runner-Up and Shubhoshree Roy as Second Runner-Up from Jharkhand, Leena Aswani from Rajasthan, Jaya Chauhan as Runner-Up from Rajasthan, Swati Bhatt from Uttarakhand, Mansi Ranjit Pawar from Maharashtra, Kanchana M from Tamil Nadu, Nidhi from Haryana, and Anuradha Roy from Bihar. Founder Rajesh Agarwal emphasized that Forever Star India stands apart as the only beauty pageant platform offering in-depth, professional training. He stated that participants are groomed not only for glamour and fashion but also to excel confidently in diverse professional fields.

Each contestant is provided with a unique digital ID, which is strategically promoted by digital experts to achieve strong visibility and top rankings on Google, ensuring long-term personal branding.

Renowned Choreography, Designers, and Makeup Excellence

blogs.title: From Home Kitchen to National Honor: Udaipur Chef Becomes Super Woman Awardee 2025
blogs.short_content: Shirin Zakiuddin Gorakhpurwala’s inspiring journey from home kitchen to national fame as a Super Woman Awardee 2025 celebrates culinary excellence and innovation.
blogs.content:
A Journey from Home Kitchen to National Acclaim

Udaipur: Shirin Zakiuddin Gorakhpurwala, a celebrated culinary achiever in the beginning from Banswara and now based in Nashik, has been recognized as one of the best home made professional chefs in the country. Known for her proper flavours, culinary innovation, and mastery over homemade cuisine - specifically Dawoodi Bohra delicacies and Indian fusion dishes - Shirin’s upward push from cooking for small gatherings to winning national accolades is truly inspiring. She has been honored with the distinguished Super Woman Award 2025 on the Forever Star India Awards, recognizing her excellence in the culinary world and her influence on aspiring chefs nationwide.

Early Beginnings: Passion Meets Purpose

Born into a traditional Dawoodi Bohra family in Banswara, Rajasthan, Shirin balanced early responsibilities as a  young wife and mother of two while nurturing her deep passion for cooking. Her culinary career took shape after she moved to Udaipur and began honing her talents, to begin with cooking homemade food for social gatherings, events, and small celebrations. Her commitment to quality soon led her to undergo professional training under acclaimed chefs such as Chef Vimal Dhar and Chef Sangeeta Dhar, sharpening her skills and broadening her culinary perspective. 

Career Milestones and National Recognition

Shirin’s skills shone through when she reached the Semi-Finals of the MasterChef India auditions in New Delhi in each 2016 and 2019 - a remarkable achievement reflecting her culinary prowess. She went on to win the Star Chef Competition Udaipur (Season 1, 2016), presented by Celebrity Chef Harpal Singh Sokhi. Her success opened doors to new opportunities, including collaborations with Wonderchef (Chef Sanjeev Kapoor) and serving dishes for noted chefs like Varun Inamdar.

In 2019, she realized her entrepreneurial dream by opening Tastebuds Restaurant in Banswara. She later expanded into frozen foods, ready-to-eat meals, and released a Cloud Kitchen in Udaipur in 2024 alongside her daughter Arwa. Today, Shirin is progressing towards establishing a fine-dine restaurant and building a PAN-India food franchise network.

Empowering Through Excellence

Shirin Zakiuddin Gorakhpurwala’s success story is a testament to resilience, expertise, and entrepreneurial spirit. By blending traditional cuisine with modern innovation, she has inspired other homemakers to pursue culinary goals professionally. Her popularity with the Super Woman Award 2025 by using Forever Star India not only highlights her culinary achievements but also celebrates her role as a source of inspiration for aspiring chefs and food entrepreneurs across India.

All jury members extended their best wishes to the contestants for the upcoming Forever Miss Universe and Miss India Grand Finale.

He further explained that before registration, each contestant’s profile is assigned a unique ID, which is maintained by digital experts on Google and other social platforms. This ensures that the contestants’ profiles gain global visibility and a lasting presence.

blogs.title: The Journey to Miss Universe 2026 Begins: Auditions Now Open
blogs.short_content: Auditions for Forever Miss Universe 2026 are now open. Join Forever Star India’s premier platform empowering women through grooming, training, and global pageant opportunities.
blogs.content:
A New Era of Global Glamour and Talent

The journey toward one of the world’s most celebrated beauty titles has officially begun, as auditions for Forever Miss Universe 2026 are now open. This marks the beginning of a new chapter for thousands of aspiring models, performers, and changemakers from across the country who dream of stepping onto the global stage. Organized by Forever Star India, the event promises to bring together extraordinary talent, exceptional confidence, and inspiring personal stories that redefine modern womanhood.

Forever Star India Leads the Way

As one of India’s most influential pageant and expertise platforms, Forever Star India has all over again taken the highlight by launching an audition season that is set to be grander than ever before. With a popularity for transparency, high-quality grooming, and world-class event execution, the organization is committed to preparing contestants for the global area. Their continued dedication ensures that the journey to Forever Miss Universe 2026 is not just a competition but a transformative experience for every participant.

What Awaits Participants in the 2026 Edition

The Forever Miss Universe 2026 auditions will focus on identifying women who reflect intelligence, compassion, cultural understanding, and leadership. Beyond physical beauty, the event emphasizes personality, communication skills, talent, social awareness, and originality.

Selected candidates will undergo a structured training program that includes:

  • Personality development and grooming sessions
     
  • Runway and stage presence workshops
     
  • Public speaking and interview training
     
  • Fitness and wellness guidance
     
  • Talent performance mentoring

    These preparatory stages help shape contestants into strong, confident individuals ready to represent India on the global Miss Universe platform.

A Platform of Empowerment

For many participants, this journey becomes a defining moment in their professional and personal growth. The auditions serve as a national platform where young women benefit from visibility, build networks, and discover new opportunities in modeling, entertainment, and public leadership. For several years, Harshil has been actively involved in numerous humanitarian initiatives aimed at assisting vulnerable individuals and families. His efforts include offering shelter, clothing, and important assistance to the ones struggling with economic hardships. One of his most notable contributions is paying school fees for orphaned kids, ensuring they have got access to schooling and a better future. Additionally, he regularly distributes ration kits to widows, helping them sustain their everyday needs with dignity.

Beyond transactional help, Harshil strives to convey emotional warmth to underserved families. He celebrates festivals with financially weak individuals and children, spreading joy and ensuring that nobody feels disregarded at some point of unique events. blogs.short_content: Astrologer Rajesh Agarwal’s leadership and vision have transformed Forever Star India into a powerful platform celebrating national talent and real achievers.
blogs.content:
Rajesh Agrawal’s Exceptional Rise in the Global Business Landscape
Jaipur / Renowned international astrologer Rajesh Agrawal has achieved remarkable success in business within just five years, setting new milestones in the field. Through the precise application of astrology and vastu principles, combined with hard work and dedication, Rajesh has elevated Forever Star India Company to the ranks of the world’s top companies. 

Mastery in KP Astrology and Global Clientele

Serving Over 20,000 Clients Worldwide
For the past 18 years, Rajesh, an expert in Krishnamurti Paddhati (KP) astrology, has provided services to over 20,000 clients across India and abroad in fields such as medicine, business, politics, law, and many others - including several well-known personalities. During the COVID-19 lockdown, Rajesh had an opportunity for self-reflection and discovered that his own horoscope did not show any strong combinations for business success. 

Overcoming Weak Planetary Combinations Through Astrology
At that time, he aspired to achieve something significant in the world of fashion and glamour, but due to a weak Venus (Shukra), it seemed unlikely. In conversation, Rajesh shared that the planets creating negative influences in one’s horoscope can be turned positive through specific astrological remedies. Demonstrating this practically, he transformed these negative influences and, within just five years, propelled Forever Star India into one of the leading global companies in the fashion and glamour industry. 

Establishing a Strong International Identity
Today, Forever Star India has established a global identity through modeling, beauty pageants, and various award shows, and the company is now preparing for its IPO launch. Rajesh emphasized an important point - the true purpose of astrology is to transform negativity into positivity. There are no permanent hardships written in one’s destiny; rather, the effects of planets change according to a person’s actions (karma). 

Importance of Timing, Purpose, and Planetary Remedies
If planetary positions are accurately analyzed and practical remedies are applied, obstacles in the present and near future can be successfully overcome. He further explained that timing and purpose are crucial in achieving success - knowing what to do, when, and for what reason makes a significant difference. It is noteworthy that the trophies and ID logos designed for participants in Forever Star India’s events were created based on astrological calculations. 

Growth Across Education, Business, and Professional Fields
As a result, many participants have experienced noticeable growth and positive changes in their education, business, and professional lives. Even the name and logo of Forever Star India were designed according to astrology and vastu principles, which continues to bring consistent success to the company.

blogs.content:

Currently studying in Class 11, Kunjan has shown equal interest in modeling, fashion, swimming, travel, sports, and literature. Watching videos of international supermodels like Kendall Jenner and Gigi Hadid inspired her and introduced her to the world of modeling for the first time.

Along with academics, Kunjan has excelled in sports as well. At just 15 years of age, she has earned 3 gold medals, 1 bronze medal, and has participated in several state - level competitions in basketball tournaments, making a strong name in the sports world too.

Kunjan has also secured first place in a poem-writing competition at the school level, displaying her talent in literature as well.

Expressing gratitude, Kunjan thanked Rajesh Agarwal, Founder and CEO of Forever Star India, and Director Jaya Chauhan, acknowledging the role of such platforms. She stated that platforms like Forever Miss Teen India provide young talent with a strong opportunity to showcase their abilities and boost their confidence.

blogs.title: Ratnesh Gupta Earns Super Hero Award for Excellence in Education, Literature & Social Service
blogs.short_content: Ratnesh Gupta receives the prestigious Super Hero Award for his excellence in education, skill development, social leadership, and youth empowerment in Gwalior.
blogs.content:
Gwalior’s Ratnesh Gupta Honored with Prestigious “Super Hero Award” for Excellence in Education, Skill Development & Social Leadership

Gwalior’s distinguished achiever, Ratnesh Gupta, has been honored with the prestigious Super Hero Award, recognizing his exceptional contributions across education, skill development, literature, and social welfare. His achievement once again highlights the extraordinary talent emerging from the city of Gwalior.

A graduate in Computer Science and Engineering, Ratnesh continued his academic journey in management studies and is currently pursuing post-graduation from Annamalai University, Tirunelveli. As the Director of GATEIIT Academy, he has helped thousands of students achieve top-level guidance, setting new benchmarks in competitive exam preparation.

Beyond academics, he plays a crucial role in social development. Serving as a District Officer for the National Human Rights & Crime Control Organization (NHRCCO) and a Master Trainer for the National Service Scheme (NSS), Ratnesh has continually undertaken responsibilities aimed at youth empowerment and community welfare.

His contribution to literature also reflects his creative roots. His book, “Main Samajhta Nahin, Balki Pehchanta Hoon – Ek Vishwas Ka Prateek,” has been appreciated for its thoughtful expression and inspiring message.

This award marks a significant milestone in Ratnesh Gupta’s multi-dimensional career, celebrating his dedication to education, leadership, and social upliftment.

blogs.title: How to Nominate Yourself for the National Achiever Award
blogs.short_content: Nominate yourself for the National Achiever Award 2025 by Forever Star India. Showcase your excellence, submit achievements, and gain national recognition.
blogs.content:
If you’ve been creating an impact in your profession, community, or industry, it’s time to make your recognition official. The National Achiever Award, organized by Forever Star India, is one of the most prestigious platforms in the country, designed to honor individuals who have demonstrated excellence, leadership, and dedication in their respective fields.

Nominating yourself for this award is simple and empowering - giving achievers across India a chance to showcase their talent on a national and international level.

Step-by-Step Guide to Nominate Yourself

  1. Visit the Official Website:
    Go to www.fsia.in/forever-achievers. This is the official portal of Forever Star India, where nominations for the National Achiever Award 2025 are open.
     
  2. Choose Your Category:
    Whether you’re an entrepreneur, educator, artist, doctor, designer, social worker, or corporate professional, select the category that best represents your field of achievement.
     
  3. Fill in the Registration Form:
    Enter your personal and professional details, highlighting your work, milestones, and accomplishments that make you stand out.
     
  4. Submit Your Achievements and Supporting Documents:
    Upload relevant photos, certificates, or work samples that showcase your contribution and credibility in your field.
     
  5. Get Shortlisted and Recognized:
    Once your profile is verified, you’ll receive confirmation and updates regarding your selection for the Forever Star India National Achiever Award 2025.

    Why You Should Apply

Awardees receive an official certificate, trophy, digital recognition on Google, a personalized achiever profile, and media visibility across India - all proudly backed by Forever Star India’s trusted legacy.

So, take the step today - nominate yourself and let your success inspire the nation.

blogs.title: From Vision to Victory: Astrologer Rajesh Builds a Global Business Empire in Five Years
blogs.short_content: Renowned astrologer Rajesh Agrawal transformed Forever Star India into a global fashion and glamour brand using astrology and vastu principles for success.
blogs.content:
Jaipur /  Renowned international astrologer Rajesh Agrawal has achieved remarkable success in business within just five years, setting new milestones in the field. Through the precise application of astrology and vastu principles, combined with hard work and dedication, Rajesh has elevated Forever Star India Company to the ranks of the world’s top companies. 

For the past 18 years, Rajesh, an expert in Krishnamurti Paddhati (KP) astrology, has provided services to over 20,000 clients across India and abroad in fields such as medicine, business, politics, law, and many others - including several well-known personalities. During the COVID-19 lockdown, Rajesh had an opportunity for self-reflection and discovered that his own horoscope did not show any strong combinations for business success. 

At that time, he aspired to achieve something significant in the world of fashion and glamour, but due to a weak Venus (Shukra), it seemed unlikely. In conversation, Rajesh shared that the planets creating negative influences in one’s horoscope can be turned positive through specific astrological remedies. Demonstrating this practically, he transformed these negative influences and, within just five years, propelled Forever Star India into one of the leading global companies in the fashion and glamour industry. 

Today, Forever Star India has established a global identity through modeling, beauty pageants, and various award shows, and the company is now preparing for its IPO launch. Rajesh emphasized an important point - the true purpose of astrology is to transform negativity into positivity. There are no permanent hardships written in one’s destiny; rather, the effects of planets change according to a person’s actions (karma). 

If planetary positions are accurately analyzed and practical remedies are applied, obstacles in the present and near future can be successfully overcome. He further explained that timing and purpose are crucial in achieving success - knowing what to do, when, and for what reason makes a significant difference. It is noteworthy that the trophies and ID logos designed for participants in Forever Star India’s events were created based on astrological calculations. 

As a result, many participants have experienced noticeable growth and positive changes in their education, business, and professional lives. Even the name and logo of Forever Star India were designed according to astrology and vastu principles, which continues to bring consistent success to the company.

blogs.title: भारत के सुपर हीरो बनने का सुनहरा मौका – ऐसे करें शुरुआत
blogs.short_content: जानिए भारत के सुपर हीरो कैसे बने और सुपर हीरो अवॉर्ड जीतें। फ़ॉरएवर स्टार इंडिया आपके योगदान और प्रेरणा को सम्मानित करता है।
blogs.content:
देश में हर साल ऐसे कई लोग उभरते हैं जो अपने कार्यों और समाज के लिए योगदान से प्रेरणा का स्रोत बनते हैं। अगर आप भी सोच रहे हैं “भारत के सुपर हीरो कैसे बने?”, तो यह आपके लिए सुनहरा अवसर है। आज की दुनिया में सिर्फ कामयाबी ही नहीं, बल्कि समाज और लोगों पर सकारात्मक प्रभाव डालना ही किसी व्यक्ति को असली हीरो बनाता है।

ऐसे ही नायकों को सम्मानित करने का उद्देश्य लेकर सुपर हीरो अवॉर्ड 2025 का आयोजन किया जा रहा है, जिसमें देशभर में विभिन्न क्षेत्रों से अग्रणी पुरुषों को उनके उत्कृष्ट योगदान के लिए चुना जाएगा। यह 7वाँ सीज़न है और पूरे भारत से 70 से अधिक वर्गों में आवेदन आमंत्रित किए गए हैं। 

सुपर हीरो बनने के लिए जरूरी है कि आप अपने क्षेत्र में उत्कृष्टता और समर्पण दिखाएं। चाहे आप शिक्षा, स्वास्थ्य, व्यापार, सामाजिक कार्य, या किसी भी पेशे में हों - आपका लक्ष्य समाज को बेहतर बनाना होना चाहिए। लगातार मेहनत, ईमानदारी, और दूसरों की मदद करने का जुनून आपको भीड़ से अलग पहचान दिलाता है। यही गुण आपको सुपर हीरो अवॉर्ड जैसे प्रतिष्ठित राष्ट्रीय सम्मान की ओर ले जाते हैं।

इस पुरस्कार के तहत चयनित व्यक्तियों को कई विशेष लाभ मिलते हैं: एक QR कोड सक्षम प्रमाण पत्र, सोशल मीडिया बायो में उपयोग के लिए प्रोफेशनल प्रोफाइल लिंक, अथॉरिटी SEO टीम द्वारा गूगल में लिस्टिंग, तथा विभिन्न न्यूज़ पोर्टल्स में कवर की गई रिपोर्टें। आवेदन प्रक्रिया सरल है - भारत का नागरिक होना आवश्यक है, आयु 18 वर्ष से अधिक होनी चाहिए, तथा संबंधित व्यवसाय या पेशे में न्यूनतम एक वर्ष का अनुभव होना चाहिए। 

यदि आप इस महान मंच का हिस्सा बनना चाहते हैं | और समाज अनुभव, प्रेरणा और असाधारण सफलताओं के साथ एक नई पहचान बनाना चाहते हैं, तो समय अभी है कदम उठाने का। अब सोचिए मत - आज ही आवेदन करें, अपना बायोडाटा तैयार करें, अपने काम की तस्वीरें अपलोड करें और भारत के अगले सुपर हीरो बनने की दिशा में पहला कदम उठाएं।

यह सिर्फ एक पुरस्कार नहीं - यह आपके काम और समाज में आपके योगदान की पहचान है। अपने सपनों को सच करने और दूसरों के लिए प्रेरणा बनने का यही सही समय है। फ़ॉरएवर स्टार इंडिया ऐसे नायकों को पहचानता और सम्मानित करता है, जो देश और समाज के लिए वास्तविक बदलाव लाते हैं।

The entire event will be broadcast live across various social media platforms, offering global visibility to all participants. Following the winners of the global fashion and modeling competition, each winner will be awarded a unique global identity through a personalized ID, enhancing their recognition and reach within the fashion and beauty industry. 

The crowned Forever Miss Universe 2025 will be presented with a title sash, crown, bouquet, memento, certificate of excellence, and several exciting gifts. blogs.title: Jaipur Pink City Star Meenakshi Honored at Most Prestigious Beauty Pageant Event
blogs.short_content: Jaipur Pink City Star Meenakshi Honored at Most Prestigious Beauty Pageant Event
blogs.content:
An enthusiastic girl, Meenakshi, loves listening to songs since childhood, and for her career, she studied business administration and worked in the corporate world. Such fields have grown her into a hard-knock, diverse woman. Meenakshi emerged victorious as the city winner by representing her own city. Pink City girl Meenakshi is a dynamic personality who thrives on embracing challenges and transforming them into meaningful experiences. Participated in the beauty pageant event called ‘City Winner’ organized by Forever Star India, which is associated with pan-India, and won the title Mrs. Jaipur 2025. This event is a city-level beauty pageant event organized by Forever Star India as part of their national competition for married women. 

In the words of CEO and Founder Rajesh Agarwal, Forever Star India is the only beauty pageant platform in the world that works as a community and has immense potential for future exposure. Additionally, the director of Forever Star India, Jaya Chouhan, added a few more points on becoming a winner with Forever Star India. Becoming the city winner is a significant milestone in Meenakshi's life and places her at the forefront of the fashion industry. She feels proud to represent her city and state on various platforms and to make a positive impact on society. This title is not just for the crown, but a reflection of her journey filled with passion, perseverance, and an inspiring pursuit of greatness. She is currently engaged in managing a home and raising her children.  

Unfortunately, Meenakshi felt stuck during her journey, as managing both life and career responsibilities was a challenging aspect of her life. However, with crucial support from her father and husband, who assisted her in developing self-confidence. Furthermore, Forever Star India provided her the correct platform to bring back her confidence, and she started pursuing her dreams again.
In her acceptance speech, Meenakshi emphasized her commitment to social work and highlighted her ongoing efforts to inspire married women to rediscover themselves and work towards their goals and to challenge conventional stereotypes related to beauty and age. Her dedication to these causes underscores her passion for creating a positive impact both within and beyond her professional realm. At last, Meenakshi would like to thank and show gratitude towards her father, husband, and to forever star India for the success.

blogs.content:
Forever Miss India 2025 City Finale has been recognised for its landmark celebration, as it organizes engaging contests of talent, beauty, and empowerment across various cities in India. In one of its grand events, which was organised and administered by Forever Star India, winners from over 70 cities were honoured as Forever Miss India 2025. 

The Indian beauty pageant industry witnessed a transformative shift as Forever Miss India 2025 City Finale was organised by Forever Star India in various cities. This contest was different from traditional beauty contests as the initiative was designed not only to celebrate charm but also to empower participants with respect, recognition, and long-term visibility. The Forever Miss India contest 2025 received thousands of applicants representing diverse backgrounds and in multiple categories. Furthermore, following strict selection rounds, the winners were announced not only based on their beauty and style but also for their confidence, determination, and ability to inspire. 

Under the visionary leadership of Rajesh Agarwal, CEO and Founder of Forever Star India, and the strategic direction of Director Jaya Chauhan, the event was a great success, creating numerous career opportunities for Miss India industry events. The event followed the vision of Forever Star India, “पहचान के साथ सम्मान”. The city finale winners were given a platform to highlight their journey, achievements, and individuality. The profiles developed provided wide opportunities to build networks throughout the field of beauty pageants and the fashion industry.

blogs.short_content: Forever Star India's Miss India 2024, Mrs India 2024 and Miss Teen India 2024 city finale will be held in August 2024.
blogs.content:
India's largest women empowerment platform "Forever Star India" has announced the city finale of the 4th season of Miss India, Mrs India, and Miss Teen India.

City winners will be announced from 23 August to 25 August 2024

Winners will be selected from 200 Cities of India

Crowning Ceremony will be held in 200 Episodes

 

For the first time in India, a beauty contest will be broadcast in 200 episodes. Winners from 200 cities will be crowned "City Winners". One episode of one city will be recorded and broadcast.

USP of Forever Star India’s Beauty Pageant:

  1. Celebrity Endorsements: Famous Bollywood personalities like Bhayashree and Malika Arora have participated so far and in the coming time, more big names will be made a part of this show.

  2. Extensive Training Programs: Forever Star India is a specially designed platform for all common people. Here the best experts of India prepare you with training, grooming, and etiquettes. So that you feel comfortable on the ramp and can perform your best.

  3. Diverse Age Categories: Forever Star India invites applications in the categories of Miss, Mrs. and Miss Teen India. This means that girls from 12 to 50 years of age who want to make a career in modeling and acting or want to fulfill their dreams can become a part of this beauty contest.

  4. High Visibility for Participants: FSIA ID of all City Winners, State Winners, and National Winners are given top rank on Google with their title keywords so that the winners get proper exposure. Also, videos of all the winners are uploaded on YouTube which gives special recognition to all the models

  5. Media Coverage: Forever Star India winners get the opportunity to gain global recognition. News of all winners is published by top media houses in multiple news websites and press media.

  6. Community and Networking: Forever Star India works like a community. People from different professions and cities can communicate here and take their profession forward for growth.

 

Winners to Crown in Exclusive 200 Episodes:

Forever Star India is going to create history, for the first time in history; the crowning ceremony of 200 winners will be organized in 200 episodes. There will be an individual episode for each city winner, which will include their crowning, as well as winning speech, introduction, family celebration. This will be the first time when the crowning ceremony of a city winner will be promoted on such a large scale. A proper episode will be designed for each city winner. Then this specially designed episode will be given top rank on Google through YouTube and website.

Celebrate Special Moment with Your Love Ones:

Forever Star India will organize this grand ceremony in August 2024, where all the winners will be crowned online. The winner’s trophy and merit certificate will be handed over to them by their close family members. Gather your family, dress up impressively and get ready to make memories that will last a lifetime as you are going to be a part of this incredible occasion.

The State and National level Crowning Ceremony is scheduled for December 2024, in which more than 200 city winners will participate and compete to become the winner at the next level.

blogs.title: Rajesh Agarwal, CEO and Founder of Forever Star India, Launched the New Feature of FSIA Social Media
blogs.short_content: Rajesh Agarwal, CEO and Founder of Forever Star India has announced New Social Media Feature of FSIA, Every Verified Member Now can share thoughts on FSIA Social Media.
blogs.content:
Rajesh Agarwal, CEO and Founder of Forever Star India Awards (FSIA), announced a new feature on the FSIA Social Media platform in a press conference today. This new feature has been introduced to improve social media engagement and user experience.

Top Ranked FSIA Social ID on Google gives Verified Members a Global Identity, thereby taking their Personal and Professional Career to New Heights

Rajesh Agarwal told that Forever Star India is a social media platform of verified members, where members from different walks of life, regions, languages, cultures, fields of work, and experiences share a platform. With the help of this feature, users can post their awards, certificates, and recognitions directly on FSIA social media platform. This feature will be beneficial not only for FSIA members but also for their supporters and followers.

Forever Star India has emerged as a Leading Platform in providing Top Google Rankings to its Verified Members

Agarwal said, "Our goal has always been to provide our members with the best possible platform where they can showcase their achievements. With this new social media feature, we will be able to provide even more visibility and recognition to our members."

He further said that "Just like any user can create their ID on other social media platforms, only verified members can create their ID on Forever Star India. These verified members are those who are achievers, are reputed, and make excellent contributions in their field of work. These members can explain their identity on their Forever Star India social media ID, show their achievements to the world, and showcase their creative and videos.

Forever Star India has become the First Platform to bring such Unique Social Media Concepts on its Website

Forever Star India has become a global brand, playing an important role in creating an identity for its community members on Google like social media. Forever Star India has been a pioneer in giving global recognition to its members. Community members rank top on Google with their titles, which gives them global exposure and also creates their distinct identity in the world"

On the launch of the new feature of FSIA, there was a lot of enthusiasm and praise among the members and supporters. Many members found this feature innovative and helpful and expressed hope to strengthen their professional network through it.

Soon Forever Star India is going to bring many more New Features on its Website along with providing E-Commerce opportunity which will prove to be icing on the cake

Rajesh Agarwal also informed that many more new updates and improvements are being made on the FSIA social media platform which will be rolled out in the coming months. “Our team is constantly working on new features and improvements to provide our users with a seamless and enriched experience,” he said.

Forever Star India Awards, which recognises excellence and achievements in different sectors across the country every year, is now focusing on further strengthening its social media presence. The launch of this new feature is another step in the same direction.

blogs.title: लोकसभा चुनाव 2024 की भविष्यवाणी: 343+ सीटों के साथ भाजपा की बड़ी जीत, मोदी बनेंगे तीसरी बार प्रधामंत्री
blogs.short_content: लोकसभा चुनाव 2024 की भविष्यवाणी: भारत के सबसे बड़े ज्योतिषी राजेश अग्रवाल ने लोकसभा चुनाव 2024 की भविष्यवाणी की है और मोदी को तीसरी बार प्रधानमंत्री बनने का दावा किया है, साथ ही 343+ सीटों से बहुमत मिलने की संभावना व्…
blogs.content:
लोकसभा चुनाव 2024 से पहले एक महत्वपूर्ण भविष्यवाणी में, एस्ट्रो राज के नाम से मशहूर ज्योतिषी राजेश अग्रवाल ने भारतीय जनता पार्टी (भाजपा) की शानदार जीत की भविष्यवाणी की है। एस्ट्रो राज के अनुसार, भाजपा 343 से ज़्यादा सीटें जीतने जा रही है, जिससे आगामी चुनावों में उसे प्रचंड बहुमत मिलने वाला है। इस शानदार जीत से नरेंद्र मोदी अभूतपूर्व तीसरी बार भारत के प्रधानमंत्री बनेंगे। और देश में शासन और बदलाव के एक नए युग की शुरुआत करेंगे।

 

एस्ट्रोराज की भविष्यवाणी

भाजपा के 343+ सीटें हासिल करने की भविष्यवाणी अपने प्रतिद्वंद्वियों पर महत्वपूर्ण बढ़त का संकेत देती है। यह परिणाम न केवल लोकसभा में स्पष्ट बहुमत सुनिश्चित करेगा, बल्कि भारतीय राजनीति में भाजपा की पकड़ को भी मजबूत करेगा।

 

नरेंद्र मोदी: तीसरे कार्यकाल के लिए तैयार

नरेंद्र मोदी तीसरी बार भारत के प्रधानमंत्री के रूप में पदभार संभालेंगे। उनके कार्यकाल में पर्याप्त आर्थिक सुधार, बुनियादी ढांचे के विकास पर ध्यान केंद्रित करना और विदेश नीति में महत्वपूर्ण प्रगति हुई है। एक और कार्यकाल में इन पहलों की निरंतरता और विस्तार देखने को मिलेगा, जो वैश्विक मंच पर भारत की दिशा को नया आकार देगा।

समग्र भविष्यवाणी के अतिरिक्त, एस्ट्रो राज ने क्षेत्रीय परिणामों पर विशिष्ट अंतर्दृष्टि प्रदान की है:

  1. राजस्थान: राजस्थान में 2019 चुनाव के मुकाबले बीजेपी को 2-3 सीटों का नुकसान हो सकता है, यहां 22 या 23 सीटें जीत सकती है

  2. पश्चिम बंगाल: पिछले लोकसभा चुनाव की तुलना में इस बार भाजपा को 8 से 10 सीटों का फायदा होने की उम्मीद है, जो भाजपा के बेहतर प्रदर्शन को दर्शाता है।

  3. दक्षिण भारत: भाजपा का प्रदर्शन सराहनीय रहने की उम्मीद है; पिछले चुनाव की तुलना में दक्षिण भारत से अधिक सीटें जीतने की संभावना है। कुछ दक्षिणी राज्यों में भाजपा को सीटें मिलेंगी और कुछ राज्यों में सीटें घटने की संभावना है।

एस्ट्रो राज (राजेश अग्रवाल) के बारे में

एस्ट्रो राज या राजेश अग्रवाल, एक मशहूर ज्योतिषी हैं, जिनके पास प्रेम, स्वास्थ्य, खेल आयोजन और राजनीतिक नतीजों सहित जीवन के विभिन्न पहलुओं को कवर करने वाली भविष्यवाणियों का एक विस्तृत पोर्टफोलियो है। अपनी सटीक और व्यावहारिक भविष्यवाणियों के लिए मशहूर, एस्ट्रो राज 2008 से ज्योतिष में एक भरोसेमंद नाम रहे हैं। उनकी सेवाएँ उनकी वेबसाइट और विशेष सॉफ़्टवेयर के ज़रिए उपलब्ध हैं, जिससे उनकी विशेषज्ञ सलाह व्यापक दर्शकों के लिए उपलब्ध है।

एस्ट्रो राज की पिछली भविष्यवाणियां सटीक साबित होने के बाद, सभी की निगाहें लोकसभा चुनाव 2024 के परिणामों पर होंगी कि क्या उनका नवीनतम पूर्वानुमान सही साबित होता है।

  • No need for travel, ensuring convenience and safety.
  • It saves travel time and expenses.
  • Families can enjoy the crowning ceremony together from the comfort of their homes.
  • Sashes and certificates will be couriered directly to the winners' homes.

 

Winners from each city will not only be crowned but also receive top Google rankings through their official Forever Star India profiles and YouTube videos, boosting their visibility and online presence. Forever Star India is dedicated to creating a global identity and promoting women empowerment, offering contestants the opportunity to showcase their talents on city, state, and national levels.

The selection of city winners for Forever Miss India 2024 will be based on live performances, dressing sense, makeup, representation skills, etiquette, and overall performance. Successful candidates will advance to the state, national, and international levels, culminating in a grand finale ceremony in December.

 

Forever Miss India 2024 is more than a beauty pageant; it's a platform for women to display their skills and gain recognition, contributing to their personal and professional growth. As the anticipation builds, all eyes are on the upcoming live ceremony, where the brightest talents from every city will shine.

blogs.short_content: How to Apply for the National Award 2024 - Forever Star India is inviting Nominations for Super Hero Award 2024, Super Woman Award 2024, and Business Award 2024, to be organized in August 2024.
blogs.content:
Forever Star India's National Award Ceremony in August, 2024

Nominations are Invited in 70+ Categories

The National Award 2024 is a prestigious recognition that honors individuals who have made significant contributions to their field. Whether you are an artist, scientist, educator, or social worker, the National Award celebrates excellence and innovation in various fields. If you aspire to receive this esteemed award in 2024, here's a comprehensive guide on how to apply:

Step 1: Eligibility Criteria

Before you begin the application process, ensure that you meet the eligibility criteria set forth by the National Award committee. The criteria may vary depending on the category of the award, so be sure to carefully review the guidelines provided.

Step 2: Choose the Right Category

The National Award encompasses various categories, including but not limited to arts, science, literature, education, and social work. Determine the category that best aligns with your achievements and expertise.

Step 3: Gather Your Documentation

Prepare a comprehensive portfolio that highlights your achievements, contributions, and impact in your field. This may include:

  • Resume/CV: Provide a detailed overview of your professional background, qualifications, and accomplishments.
  • Work Samples: Include samples of your work, such as publications, research papers, artworks, or project reports.
  • Letters of Recommendation: Obtain letters of recommendation from peers, mentors, or industry experts who can attest to your contributions and achievements.
  • Supporting Documents: Include any additional documents that support your application, such as awards, certificates, or media coverage.

Step 4: Complete the Application Form

Visit the official website of the National Award to access the application form. Fill out the form accurately and completely, providing all the required information and documentation.

Step 5: Submit Your Application

Once you have completed the application form and gathered all the necessary documentation, submit your application as per the instructions provided. Ensure that you meet the deadline for submissions.

Step 6: Await the Decision

After submitting your application, the National Award committee will review your submission and evaluate your candidacy. The selection process may involve a thorough assessment of your portfolio and an interview.

Step 7: Receive the Award

If your application is successful, you will be notified by the National Award committee and invited to receive the award at a prestigious ceremony. The award not only recognizes your achievements but also serves as a testament to your dedication and excellence in your field.

blogs.title: Moringa Olifera Tablets for Boost Metabolism
blogs.short_content: Moringa Olifera Tablets for Boost Metabolism, Derived from the leaves of the Moringa oleifera tree, these tablets have gained popularity for their purported ability to boost metabolism, thereby supporting weight manag…
blogs.content:
In a world where health and wellness are increasingly becoming a priority for many, the search for natural remedies and supplements that can aid in achieving optimal well-being is ever-ongoing. Among the plethora of options available, one particular product has been making waves in the health community – Forever Leaves Moringa Olifera Tablets.

Derived from the leaves of the Moringa oleifera tree, these tablets have gained popularity for their purported ability to boost metabolism, thereby supporting weight management and overall health. But what exactly sets Forever Leaves Moringa Olifera Tablets apart from other supplements? Let's delve deeper into the science behind this natural powerhouse.

First and foremost, Moringa oleifera is often referred to as the "miracle tree" due to its rich nutritional profile. Packed with vitamins, minerals, antioxidants, and amino acids, this superfood has been used for centuries in traditional medicine for its various health benefits. From combating inflammation to promoting cardiovascular health, Moringa oleifera is truly a versatile ally in the journey towards wellness.

One of the key components of Forever Leaves Moringa Tablets is their ability to enhance metabolism. Metabolism plays a crucial role in the body's ability to convert food into energy, and a faster metabolism can aid in weight loss and weight management. The nutrients present in Moringa, such as vitamin B6 and iron, play vital roles in metabolic processes, helping to optimize energy production and utilization.

Additionally, Forever Leaves Moringa Olifera Tablets contain bioactive compounds like chlorogenic acid and quercetin, which have been shown to have metabolism-boosting properties. These compounds work synergistically to stimulate thermogenesis, the process by which the body generates heat and burns calories. By increasing thermogenesis, Moringa may help to enhance calorie expenditure, supporting weight loss efforts.

Jaipur, India – March 10, 2024 – Forever Star India Awards, in association with Intra Life and Forever Lives, proudly present the fifth season of the esteemed Super Women/Hero Awards. This nationally recognized program was organized by visionary Shri Rajesh Aggarwal and directed by Jaya Chauhan.

Held at the picturesque Rose Garden of Entertainment Paradise, Jaipur on March 10, 2024, the Super Women & Super Hero Awards Season 5 celebrated the achievements of over 130 outstanding men and women from various fields. Hailing from major cities like Mumbai, Delhi, Bengaluru, Chennai, and beyond, these women were honored in over 70 categories including business, fashion, modeling, education, astrology, and medicine.

Dr. Kunwar Harshit is a Vedic astrologer and solution expert who has given successful advice or guidance to more than 11000 people at the youngest age who entered spiritual life from successful political life.

The primary objective of the Super Women/Hero Awards is to honor India's top achievers. In line with this mission, the event welcomed distinguished guests including renowned Bollywood actress Bhagyashree and respected Colonel Pratap Singh Rathore.

The event was ably hosted by the charismatic Ajit Singh who kept the audience enthralled throughout the evening. Attendees were treated to captivating performances including a mesmerizing violin recital and the launch of a special calendar.
A highlight of the evening was the unique opportunity for the achievers to gain global recognition, underscoring the event's commitment to showcasing Indian talent on the international platform.

“Super Woman/Hero Awards Season 5 continues to be an icon of inspiration, shining a light on the incredible achievements of men and women across India,” said Mr. Rajesh Agarwal, organizer of the show. “We are honored to provide a platform that celebrates their contributions and inspires future generations.”
With its unique blend of recognition, entertainment and empowerment, the Super Women/Hero Awards Season 5 reaffirmed its position as a premier event on India's cultural calendar.


This unprecedented award ceremony marks the event in our country where the recipients not only receive prestigious honors but also achieve top rankings on both Google and YouTube. Each award winner's profile will display prominently at the top of search engine results, ensuring lasting visibility and recognition. Furthermore, the moment of receiving the award will be immortalized through a video clip uploaded on YouTube and various OTT platforms, thereby guaranteeing a continuous tribute to their achievements.
